# pve_mapping_pci (Resource)

Cluster resource mapping for PCI devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_mapping_pci" "example" {
  item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
  map     = ["CHANGE_ME"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The ID of the logical PCI mapping.
- `map` (List of String) A list of maps for the cluster nodes.

### Optional

- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `description` (String) Description of the logical PCI device.
- `live_migration_capable` (Boolean) Marks the device(s) as being able to be live-migrated (Experimental). This needs hardware and driver support to work. (default: 0)
- `mdev` (Boolean) Marks the device(s) as being capable of providing mediated devices. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
